name: Weedle

name: Chespin
fl: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Fennekin
fl: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Froakie
fl: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Inkay
fl: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Honedge

fl: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Snubbull
fl: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

name: Swirlix

name: Bunnelby
fl: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

fl: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
